message.reasoning_content: We need to determine crimes based on Chinese criminal law. Facts: defendant bought prohibited cultural relics (nationally prohibited to trade) and attempted to sell for profit. Also defrauded victim of 5 million RMB by promising high profit from selling cultural relics, got money, used for personal purposes, partially returned 1 million and gave low-value items. This is fraud (诈骗罪). Also dealing in illegal cultural relics: violation of cultural relic protection law, which is a crime of illegal trafficking of cultural relics (非法买卖文物罪) under Criminal Law article 277?
